format: WebP encode only; no crop, resize or recoloring

prompts.goal:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original editorial illustration for the Ask Lumo intelligent banking feature in a Ghanaian student banking app.
Canvas: a wide horizontal landscape, approximately 2:1 aspect ratio.
Composition: LEFT 45 PERCENT of the entire canvas must be completely empty flat acid-lime #d7ff3f, uninterrupted negative space for HTML copy, no objects or texture there. Confine the illustrative scene to the RIGHT 55 PERCENT. Foreground students large and readable even when the banner is displayed at 340 by 165 pixels. Keep heads and the clock tower inside the canvas.
Scene/backdrop: University of Ghana, Legon campus. Show the recognisable Balme Library behind the students: white symmetrical low wings, pitched tiled roofs rendered in gray, arched entrance, central white rectangular clock tower with square clock face and small pyramidal tiled roof, campus steps and a few palm/plant silhouettes. Simplified faithful architectural silhouette, not a generic skyscraper or cathedral. No lettering on the building and no numerals on the clock.
Style: bold contemporary Ghanaian editorial graphic illustration, mature and energetic. Strong black ink contours, striking cut-paper shapes, flat planes, simplified natural expressive faces, dynamic confident poses. Real university-age Black Ghanaian students in modern casual streetwear and backpacks. A strong visual story rather than a small line icon. Cohesive illustration collection for a premium app. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not childish, no anthropomorphic coin mascots.
Palette: STRICTLY black, white, neutral grayscale, and acid lime #d7ff3f. Skin and hair are black or neutral gray. No brown, red, orange, purple, blue or any other hue. Fully opaque flat acid-lime background. Architecture whites and grays, confident black silhouettes, selective lime clothing details.
Constraints: NO text, letters, numbers, currency symbols, logos, captions, charts, speech bubbles, interface elements or watermark. No in-image words. No dramatic shadows in the empty left area.

Subject and story for this image:
A female student seated on a wide campus step with an open laptop balanced on her knees, looking thoughtfully and optimistically at her phone. A male student friend beside her with a backpack and notebook, sharing the planning moment. Visual theme: saving for the next thing and ambitions within reach. Large foreground figures occupy the far right; Balme Library clocktower visible behind, a few clean rising campus steps. Friendly confident body language.
